text: In 2025, South Korea launched a fiscal initiative to bolster public credit guarantee capacity for SMEs affected by trade-related shocks, domestic demand weakness, and disaster-related disruptions. The initiative, funded by a supplementary budget, aimed to expand guarantee supply, increase coverage ratios, provide fee relief, and streamline approvals through the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund (KODIT) and the Korea Technology Finance Corporation (KOTEC). This was part of a broader fiscal support strategy to stabilize financing conditions and bolster demand.
